paite: Huan Jakob in Aigupta gam ah buh a-om chih atheihtak in, Jakob in atapate kiang ah, "Bangziak a ki-en maimah na hi ua?" achi hi.
heading: Joseph Unaute Buh Lei Ding In Aigupta Ah Ahoh Uh
english: Now Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob said to his sons, “Why do you look at one another?”

paite: Amah mah in, "Ngai un, Aigupta gam ah buh a-om chih ka za hi. Si lou a i hinkhiak theihna ding in huai ah va hohsuk unla, huai a kipan ei a ding in buh va lei un," achi hi.
english: He said, “Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there, and buy for us from there, so that we may live, and not die.”

paite: Joseph sanggam sawmte Aigupta ah buh lei ding in ahohsuk uhi.
english: Joseph’s ten brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.

paite: Jakob in asanggamte kiang ah Joseph nau Benjamin ahohsak kei; tuahsia ava tuak kha ding, achih ziak in.
english: But Jacob didn’t send Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, with his brothers; for he said, “Lest perhaps harm happen to him.”

paite: Huchi in Israel tapate mi ava hohte lak ah buh lei ding in ahoh ua; Kanaan gam ah leng kial ake ngal a.
english: The sons of Israel came to buy among those who came, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

paite: Aigupta gam tung a heutu Joseph ahi a; amah huai gammi tengteng kiang a buh zuakpa ahi. Joseph sanggamte ahong pai ua, lei si in amai ah akun uhi.
english: Joseph was the governor over the land. It was he who sold to all the people of the land. Joseph’s brothers came, and bowed themselves down to him with their faces to the earth.

paite: Joseph in asanggamte ana mu a, amau ana thei lai hi. Himahleh akiang uah midang bang in akibawl a, khauhtak in amaute ahoupih hi. Akiang uah, "Koi a kipan a hong na hi ua?" achi hi. Amau, “Buh lei ding a Kanaan gam a kipan hong pai ka hi uh," achi uhi.
english: Joseph saw his brothers, and he recognized them, but acted like a stranger to them, and spoke roughly with them. He said to them, “Where did you come from?” They said, “From the land of Canaan, to buy food.”

paite: Joseph in asanggamte ana thei lai a, amaute'n ahihleh amah athei kei uh.
english: Joseph recognized his brothers, but they didn’t recognize him.

paite: Joseph in amau tungtang thu, mang a amatte atheikheta hi. Akiang uah, "Enkhe mite na hi uh. Gam venlouhna munte en ding a hong kuan na hi uh," achi hi.
english: Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed about them, and said to them, “You are spies! You have come to see the nakedness of the land.”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Ka toupa, hilou e, na sikhate buh lei ding a hong kuan ka hi uh.
english: They said to him, “No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food.

paite: Mi khat ta vek ka hi ua, midiktak ka hi uh. Na sikhate enkhe mite ka hi zenzen kei uh," achi uhi.
english: We are all one man’s sons; we are honest men. Your servants are not spies.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka taksang kei, gam venlouhna munte en ding a hong pai himah uteh," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land!”

paite: Amau, “Kou na sikhate unau sawm-le-nih, Kanaan gam a om, mi khat tapate ka hi uh. Ngai in, ka nautumpen uh tu in ka pa uh kiang ah a-om hi. Khat pen ahihleh a-om nawnta kei,” achi uhi.
english: They said, “We, your servants, are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and behold, the youngest is today with our father, and one is no more.”

paite: Joseph in akiang uah, "Enkhe mite na hi uh ka hon chih na hi mahmah uhi.
english: Joseph said to them, “It is like I told you, saying, ‘You are spies!’

paite: Hichibang a ettel na hi ding uh. Na nautumpen uh hiai a ahong pai keileh Pharaoh hinna a kichiam in hiai a kipan na pawtkhe kei hial ding uh, ka hon chi ahi.
english: By this you shall be tested. By the life of Pharaoh, you shall not go out from here, unless your youngest brother comes here.

paite: Nou ah thutak a-om hia, om lou chetna ding in na lak ua khat kisawl unla, na nau uh hon pi hen. Nou bel hen in na om phot ding uh. Huchi lou in zaw Pharaoh hinna lou a kichiam in, enkhe mite na hi mahmah uh ka hon chi ding," achi hi.
english: Send one of you, and let him get your brother, and you shall be bound, that your words may be tested, whether there is truth in you, or else by the life of Pharaoh surely you are spies.”

paite: Huchi in avek un ni thum atangsak chiat hi.
english: He put them all together into custody for three days.

paite: Ani thum ni in Joseph in akiang uah, "Ke'n Pathian ka lau ziak in, hichi in hih le uchin na hing ding uh.
english: Joseph said to them the third day, “Do this, and live, for I fear God.

paite: Midiktat na hih ualeh na unau lak uah khat na suangkul tanin uah hen in om hen.
english: If you are honest men, then let one of your brothers be bound in your prison; but you go, carry grain for the famine of your houses.

paite: Na nautumpen uh ka kiang ah hon pi un. Huchi in na thu uh atel ding a, na si kei ding uh," achi hi. Huan huchibang in ahihta uhi.
english: Bring your youngest brother to me; so will your words be verified, and you won’t die.” They did so.

paite: Amau, "I nau tung a i thilhih uh moh petmah i hi, hehpih ding a ahon nget ngutngut lai a, alungtang mangbatdan mu napi a, i ngaihkhiaksak nop louh uh. Huaiziak in hiai mangbatna in hon buak ahita," akichi uhi.
english: They said to one another, “We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he begged us, and we wouldn’t listen. Therefore this distress has come upon us.”

paite: Reuben in, "Naupang tung ah thil hihkhial kei un, chi in na kiang uah ka gen kei maw? Na ngaikhe nuam kei ua ahi. Huaiziak in ngai un, asisan phu i tung ua lak ahita ve," chi in amau adawng hi.
english: Reuben answered them, saying, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘Don’t sin against the child,’ and you wouldn’t listen? Therefore also, behold, his blood is required.”

paite: Akal ua paulet mi a-om ziak in Joseph in athugen uh athei chih athei kei uhi.
english: They didn’t know that Joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them.

paite: Ama'n amau alehngatsan a, akapta hi. Akiang uah ahong kik nawn a, amau ahoupih a, alak ua pan Simeon apituam a, amitmuh un ahenta hi.
english: He turned himself away from them, and wept. Then he returned to them, and spoke to them, and took Simeon from among them, and bound him before their eyes.

paite: Joseph in a-ipte uh buh a hihdim ding leh adangkate uh a-ip ua koih nawn chiat ding in leh lampi a nek ding pe ding in thu apia hi. Huchi in huchibang in ahihsakta hi.
heading: Joseph Sanggamte Kanaan Ah Akik Nawn Uh
english: Then Joseph gave a command to fill their bags with grain, and to restore each man’s money into his sack, and to give them food for the way. So it was done to them.

paite: Abuh uh asabiltungte aposak ua, huai a kipan apawtkheta uhi.
english: They loaded their donkeys with their grain, and departed from there.

paite: Alak ua mi khat in agiahbuk ua asabiltung an pe ding a a-ip ahonleh, adangka amuta hi. Ngai in, a-ipgong bul ah ana om hi.
english: As one of them opened his sack to give his donkey food in the lodging place, he saw his money. Behold, it was in the mouth of his sack.

paite: Asanggamte kiang ah, "Ka dangka na koih nawn uh hi veh e. Ngai un, ka ip sung ah ana om mawk hi," achi hi. Alunglel ua, "Pathian in hichibang a eite ahon bawl bangchidan adiam aw?" chi in ling kawm in aki-entuah uhi.
english: He said to his brothers, “My money is restored! Behold, it is in my sack!” Their hearts failed them, and they turned trembling to one another, saying, “What is this that God has done to us?”

paite: Kanaan gam a apa uh kiang ahong tung ua, atung ua thil tung tengteng ahilh uhi.
english: They came to Jacob their father, to the land of Canaan, and told him all that had happened to them, saying,

paite: "Huai mi, agam heutupa un, khauhtak in hon houpih a, enkhe mite ding in hon koih hi.
english: “The man, the lord of the land, spoke roughly with us, and took us for spies of the country.

paite: Kou akiang ah, midiktak ka hi uh. ‘Enkhe mite ka hi zenzen kei uh.'
english: We said to him, ‘We are honest men. We are no spies.

paite: Unau sawm-le-nih ka hi ua, ka pa uh tapate ka hi vek uh. Khat a-om nawn kei a, ka nautumpen uh tu in Kanaan gam ah ka pa uh kiang ah a-om," ka chi uhi.
english: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is no more, and the youngest is today with our father in the land of Canaan.’

paite: Huai mi, agam heutupa un ka kiang uah, "Hichi in midiktak na hi uh chih ka hon thei ding. Na sanggampa uh khat ka kiang ah nusia unla, na inkuanpih kialte a ding in buh pua unla, paita un.
english: The man, the lord of the land, said to us, ‘By this I will know that you are honest men: leave one of your brothers with me, and take grain for the famine of your houses, and go your way.

paite: Na nautumpen uh ka kiang ah hon pi un. Huchi in enkhe mite na hi kei ua, midiktak na hi zaw uh, chih ka thei ding. Huchi in na sanggampa uh ka hon pe nawn ding a, hiai gam ah sum na sinta ding uh," ahon chi, achi uhi.
english: Bring your youngest brother to me. Then I will know that you are not spies, but that you are honest men. So I will deliver your brother to you, and you shall trade in the land.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, a-ipte uh abutkhiak lai un, ngai in, a-ipsung uah adangka tun chiat uh ana om hi. Amau leh apa un adangka tunte uh amuh un alau mahmah uhi.
english: As they emptied their sacks, behold, each man’s bundle of money was in his sack. When they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were afraid.

paite: Apa uh Jakob in akiang uah, "Noute'n ka tate hon tansak na hi uh. Joseph a-om nawn kei. Simeon lah a-om nawn kei, Benjamin nangawn lah pimang na tum nawn ngal ua. Hiai thil tengteng in hon kiakkhum ahita ve," achi hi.
english: Jacob, their father, said to them, “You have bereaved me of my children! Joseph is no more, Simeon is no more, and you want to take Benjamin away. All these things are against me.”

paite: Reuben in apa kiang ah, "Na kiang a ka hon pikik nawn keileh ka tapa nihte that mai in. Amah ka khut ah hon kemsak inla, na kiang ah ka hon pikik nawn mai ding," achi hi.
english: Reuben spoke to his father, saying, “Kill my two sons, if I don’t bring him to you. Entrust him to my care, and I will bring him to you again.”

paite: Ama'n, "Ka tapa na kiang uah ahong suk kei ding. A-upa asita a, amah kia lah ahita ngal a. Na paina lam lak ah tuahsia tuak taleh ka samkangpi toh lungkhamna in han ah na tumsak ding uh," achi hi.
english: He said, “My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he only is left. If harm happens to him along the way in which you go, then you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.”
